i.norm: When NullReader is constructed with a negative size, skip() still clamps position to that negative size. The returned skip count reflects how many characters were "skipped" before hitting the (negative) boundary, which is also negative. size = -827, initial position = 0, skip requested = 382 After skip: position becomes -827 (clamped to size), return value = 382 - (382 - (-827)) = -827
